description: One call sweeps a wallet on Base, Ethereum, BNB, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon and Avalanche for live ERC-20 allowances and NFT setApprovalForAll approvals (GoPlus + explorer event logs, each re-read onchain), ranks them by risk (unlimited, unknown spender, unverified or non-contract spender, flagged) and returns a ready-to-sign revoke tx (to, data, chainId, value 0) for each risky one. Per-chain status; partial results if a chain fails. Costs $0.02.
name: approval_sweep_all_chains
